summary.business_type: Personal portfolio / freelance services (AI automation & performance marketing)
top_findings: Canonical, og:url, og:image, rel=author and all schema URLs point to the Vercel preview host mueed-portfolio-dusky.vercel.app instead of www.mueednazir.site
sitemap.xml contains only the Vercel preview URL; robots.txt Sitemap: directive points to the Vercel host
~1.1 MB of JavaScript across 10 chunks (largest 499 KB) — INP risk; content is SSR so LCP is text-based
FAQ content exists but is not marked up as FAQPage; no Service/ProfessionalService schema
Readability is college-level (FRE 40.6, FK grade 11.6) — fine for B2B but hard for broader audience
0 content images on the page — no image-search presence
quick_wins: Change metadataBase / absolute site URL in Next.js config to https://www.mueednazir.site and redeploy — fixes canonical, og tags, schema, sitemap, robots and llms.txt in one shot
Add FAQPage JSON-LD to the existing FAQ section
Add Service JSON-LD for the 4 services
Add name + value prop to the H1
Split the longest sentences (16.1 words avg) for readability

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt allows all crawlers including AI bots
meta robots index, follow with max-image-preview:large
SSR content in initial HTML (crawlable without JS)

findings.title: Canonical points to Vercel preview host
findings.description: rel=canonical, og:url, og:image, twitter:image and rel=author all hardcode https://mueed-portfolio-dusky.vercel.app. Google may index the Vercel deployment and treat mueednazir.site as a duplicate.
findings.recommendation: Set metadataBase / canonical base to https://www.mueednazir.site in the Next.js app (next.config / metadata) and redeploy. Verify the live page canonical afterwards.

findings.title: sitemap.xml lists only the Vercel preview URL
findings.description: Single <loc> is https://mueed-portfolio-dusky.vercel.app; the real domain is absent.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the sitemap from the canonical domain and resubmit in Search Console.

findings.title: robots.txt Sitemap directive points to Vercel host
findings.description: Sitemap: https://mueed-portfolio-dusky.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
findings.recommendation: Update robots.txt Sitemap line to https://www.mueednazir.site/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS present; no CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add headers via Vercel (vercel.json headers config).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: QRG quality score 90/100 — no filler, no AI-slop patterns
Strong E-E-A-T: named employer + tenure, two degrees, contact, sameAs

findings.title: Readability at college level
findings.description: FRE 40.6, FK grade 11.6, 16.1 words/sentence.
findings.recommendation: Split longest sentences; target FRE 55–65 / grade 9 for broader reach.

findings.title: Single page limits topical footprint
findings.description: All topics live on one URL — no long-tail capture for AI automation or performance marketing queries.
findings.recommendation: Consider service/case-study pages or a blog as the site grows.

findings.title: keywords meta overstuffed
findings.description: 180-char keywords meta; irrelevant to Google ranking.
findings.recommendation: Optionally remove it.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: og + twitter cards complete (but wrong domain)

findings.title: Social meta resolves to Vercel host
findings.description: og:url, og:image, twitter:image use the preview domain.
findings.recommendation: Fixed by the same metadataBase change as the canonical.

findings.title: H1 is name only
findings.description: H1 'Mueed Nazir Bhat' omits the value proposition.
findings.recommendation: Add primary keywords to the H1 (e.g. 'Mueed Nazir Bhat — AI Automation & Performance Marketing').

findings.title: No content images
findings.description: 0 tags; no visual interest or image-search presence; og-image 262 KB.
findings.recommendation: Add optimized alt-tagged visuals (work samples, previews) and recompress og-image.

findings.title: Meta description slightly long
findings.description: 171 chars truncates on desktop SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Tighten to <=155 chars.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid Person JSON-LD (rich: address, sameAs, knowsAbout, alumniOf, worksFor)

findings.title: Schema URLs reference Vercel host
findings.description: Every url/image/publisher URL in both blocks uses the preview domain.
findings.recommendation: Point all schema URLs at www.mueednazir.site.

findings.title: FAQ not marked up
findings.description: FAQ content present but no FAQPage JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema for the 5 Q&As.

findings.title: No service schema
findings.description: 4 defined services, no Service/ProfessionalService markup.
findings.recommendation: Add Service or ItemList of services.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: SSR content — LCP almost certainly text-based (no hero image)

findings.title: ~1.1 MB JavaScript payload
findings.description: 10 chunks, largest 499 KB; INP/interaction risk on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Profile bundle; code-split, remove unused deps; measure with CrUX after.

findings.title: No field data available
findings.description: PSI/CrUX quota exhausted and no API key; CWV scores are lab estimates.
findings.recommendation: Run a keyed PSI/CrUX pass and validate LCP/INP/CLS before heavy optimization.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All major AI crawlers explicitly allowed in robots.txt
Strong entity signals (name, sameAs, address, education)

findings.title: llms.txt links point to Vercel host
findings.description: All llms.txt URLs use mueed-portfolio-dusky.vercel.app.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate llms.txt with www.mueednazir.site URLs.

findings.title: Host mismatch splits AI authority
findings.description: Canonical/sitemap point to Vercel host, confusing AI crawlers about the canonical identity.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the domain canonicalization first; AI signals inherit the fix.

findings.title: llms.txt facts block lacks contact row
findings.description: Email/phone only in section prose.
findings.recommendation: Add a Contact key-fact line with email and LinkedIn URL.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No missing alt text (no content images to break)

findings.title: Zero content images
findings.description: No visual content, no image-search presence for a visual-services portfolio.
findings.recommendation: Add portfolio previews / work samples with descriptive alt text.

findings.title: og-image is 262 KB
findings.description: Heavy for a social image.
findings.recommendation: Re-compress to <150 KB (still 1200x630 min).

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Set Next.js metadataBase / canonical base to https://www.mueednazir.site and redeploy
Regenerate sitemap.xml from the canonical domain
Resubmit sitemap in Google Search Console

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add FAQPage JSON-LD for the 5 questions
Add Service JSON-LD for the 4 services
Add name + value prop to the H1
Add optimized, alt-tagged content images / work previews
Reduce JS payload (biggest chunk 499 KB); validate with CrUX
Run keyed PSI/CrUX to confirm real CWV

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Consider service pages or case-study/blog pages to widen topical footprint
Add contact key-fact row to llms.txt
Build external authority: guest posts, HARO, community answers linking to the domain

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor indexation of www.mueednazir.site in GSC after canonical fix
Re-run audit in 30 days to confirm canonical/sitemap signals
